video_goal: Demonstrate the physical and software setup process for joining a live cycling class on a Peloton Bike+.
required_subjects_and_props: Peloton Bike+, rotating touchscreen monitor, cycling shoes with Delta cleats, human hands and feet.

outline_steps.visual_action: A hand reaches behind the top edge of the Peloton Bike+ monitor and presses the physical power button.
The white Peloton logo illuminates in the center of the black touchscreen as the system boots up.
Two hands grip the left and right edges of the monitor and physically swivel the rotating screen 180 degrees until it directly faces the bike saddle.
An index finger taps a circular user profile picture on the illuminated touchscreen interface.
A finger swipes up on the glass to scroll, then taps the 'Schedule' calendar icon located on the bottom navigation bar of the UI.
The finger taps a red 'Count Me In' button located next to a listed Live Cycling Class on the schedule interface.
A hand reaches down to the center frame of the bike and twists the circular red resistance knob clockwise.
A hand pulls up the black lever under the handlebars, slides the handlebar assembly slightly forward, and pushes the lever back down to lock it.
A foot wearing a black cycling shoe with a red Delta cleat hovers directly over the right metal pedal.
The foot presses down forcefully, snapping the red cleat into the pedal mechanism with a visible interlocking movement.
The touchscreen displays a live class waiting room with a digital countdown timer ticking down from 00:15 in the center.
An index finger taps the pulsing 'Join Class' button on the screen, instantly replacing the timer with a live video feed of the cycling instructor.
